_comment: Frozen end-to-end oracle for the study fixture in study_oracle.R. Every value derived by hand from the E2SFCA equations applied to the fixture geometry, in an independent implementation. No twostep code produced any number here.

stage_6_component_A._comment: Conservation: sum_i pop_i * A_i must equal the supply of providers with positive demand. PA3 reaches only a zero-population tract, so its 3 physicians are excluded and audited. Conservation is stated against access_math because it is an algebraic identity; A05 contributes 0 to it and NA to the reported value.

_semantics_note: Updated for the change in #10: `access` is the SCIENTIFIC value and is NA for a tract outside every modelled catchment, because such a tract has no measured accessibility rather than a measured zero. `access_math` carries the zero-filled algebraic form. A tract that IS reached but scores zero -- A04, reached only by PA3, whose supply is excluded for having no demand -- keeps access 0 and reached TRUE. The conservation identity is stated against access_math, since it is an algebraic property of the equations.
